measurement_scope: Headless Chromium console proxy at five viewports and rAF proxy at 390x844/768x1024. Not field INP, physical-device frame time, GPU time, touch latency, sound, or haptic evidence. Interactive acceptance uses p95/p99 and bounded-jank ratios; it permits a bounded first CanvasKit ImageBitmap transfer but fails sustained or over-600ms stalls.
